title: Admin Center Portal Library — Canonical Data & Migration Reference
purpose: Canonical reference for finishing the prototype migration without losing Portal Admin/MCR requirements and for guiding Admin Center Portal Library information architecture.

authoritativeSources.name: Requirements checklist
authoritativeSources.role: 45,292 populated-cell review index; contains 19 unresolved follow-up cells and 1 TBD cell, plus whitespace/layout review noise

strengths: Existing model already separates global definitions from scoped site/client assignment tables.
Stable semantic keys and additive migration fixtures/equivalence tests are a strong migration foundation.
Many-to-many relationships already exist for page-fields, product-riders, rules-conditions and flow transitions.
changesBeforeRuntimeSwitch: Normalize Coverage so amount rules, underwriting bands, applicant eligibility, residency, aggregate limits and rider amount/dependency logic are queryable relations instead of fields embedded in product JSON.
Add Patterns and Flags as first-class entities with assignment/relation tables.
Add rate_tables/product_rate_tables and the rate-table display configurations.
Add question_sets/question_set_fields for the MCR's reusable health/financial/smoker/CIR/SUP-DI question families.
Add ID # and Provided by/sourceReference metadata consistently to Portal Library tables.
Persist URL parameter definitions/usage rather than keeping them only in static docs/config.
Keep JSON for payloads that are genuinely polymorphic, but do not hide columns that must be filtered, joined or audited inside definition JSON.
schemaAudit.idStrategy: Retain internal primary key + stable semantic key. Add a separate persistent numeric displayId shown as 'ID #'. Do not use table row order as ID and do not replace semantic keys with display IDs.
schemaAudit.relationshipUx: Every foreign-key/relationship value should render as a link to the related Portal Library table/record, preserving Global/Effective Site scope and selected site. Patterns includes a computed 'Related tables' link column.
schemaAudit.exports: Implement one shared table-export service/component after repository-backed tables are live. Every Portal Library table gets CSV (flat row export), XML (structured relation-aware export), and PDF (human-readable current-view export).

seedPatterns.name: Global TPA Integration Framework
seedPatterns.summary: Lookup after initial application page; resolve membership/coverage status; execute client-configured decision path.

seedPatterns.name: TPA Coverage-Based Verification
seedPatterns.summary: Used by AMA and, based on current understanding, ASCE: membership + existing coverage can trigger LexisNexis, coverage portfolio display and auto-approval; fallback to manual review.

seedPatterns.name: TPA Membership-Based Auto Approval
seedPatterns.summary: WAEPA variation: new member can auto-approve without LexisNexis/portfolio; existing member follows manual review/pending path.

seedPatterns.name: Disability Income Replacement Formula
seedPatterns.summary: Maximum Benefit = MIN(Monthly Income × Replacement %, Policy Cap), with age/plan/class exceptions, tiered percentages, fixed increments, existing-coverage offsets, and fixed/age-based exceptions.

seedPatterns.name: Coverage Amount Option Families
seedPatterns.summary: Covers fixed, set/list, range+increment, tiered ranges, range+fixed, conditional, calculated, named/code, N/A, attribute-mapped, formula-capped, base-reference, multiplier, election-only and unspecified-increment patterns.

seedFlags.name: Site has product rates
seedFlags.behavior: When false, all rate displays must be hidden; enforced by rule.

seedFlags.name: Site product rates are in PRASE
Site offers QD
seedFlags.derivation: True when at least one enabled product supports QD.

seedFlags.name: Applicant applying for QD
seedFlags.derivation: True when selected product/path is QD for applicant.

seedFlags.name: Product has QD
seedFlags.derivation: Depends on configured QD pathway and current applicant selections/amount bands.

configurationAdditions.description: Whether the estimated cost total box exposes a rate-table link/action.
Whether product cards link to their related rate table.
Presentation type for the linked rate table; product/site relationship resolves actual asset.

mcrSheetMapping.mapping: Primary product/site requirements: identifiers, amounts, riders, residency, age/restrictions, UW, questions, QD, payment, rates, underwriting entity.
QD Life underwriting overlays by age/amount/pathway; treat as underwriting overlay, not duplicate products.
QD Disability overlays including waiting/benefit period, morbidity and rate load.
DI amount formulas, classes, waiting periods, benefit periods and riders.
OE amount schedules/formulas, waiting/benefit periods and riders.
Rider definitions, amount inheritance/election/percent/multiplier patterns, eligibility and UW.
Multi-page page/section content and optionality/quote/coverage UX requirements.
Single-page variant requirements.
Attestation questions and online/PDF differences.
Supplemental DI question set and conditions.
Financial question set and calculations.
Health question library and conditional logic.
WAEPA CIR questions, explanation requirements and comments.
Read/sign content and underwriting-driven visibility; explicitly identifies underwriting flag behavior.
Smoker wording, follow-up behavior and non-smoker rate criteria.
TPA/association identity, contact, logos and dropdown behavior.
Coverage-specific online/PDF beneficiary copy.
Environment links, campaign/apply/nsc parameters and verification URLs.
Product display ordering.
Decision outcome copy linked to underwriting/QD status.
Standard underwriting questions and applicant targets.
Electronic consent content and conditions.
Disclosure text, rules and placement.

SI/GI underwriting and TPA approval behavior contains unresolved analysis/confirmation language.
Face band structure needs confirmation from rate charts/brochure.
Headers explicitly call for UW/contracts confirmation; provenance should be captured via Provided by.
Supplemental health notice says confirmation needed.
Mobility item says check with UW.
Checklist flags unresolved follow-up language; retain as source content but mark verification status until confirmed.

implementationSequence.name: Freeze canonical reference
implementationSequence.details: Use this specification + full MCR workbook as the source-of-truth for schema/data coverage. Do not switch runtime yet.

implementationSequence.name: Schema correction/additions
implementationSequence.details: Add normalized coverage relations, Patterns, Flags, rate tables, question sets, ID #, Provided by and MCR source traceability.

implementationSequence.name: MCR ingestion/accounting
implementationSequence.details: Map all 23 MCR sheets into canonical tables. Seed prototype clients fully. For non-prototype clients, preserve normalized catalog/rule/pattern data without requiring a runnable Site yet.

implementationSequence.name: Equivalence + completeness gates
implementationSequence.details: Extend equivalence tests and add MCR traceability/completeness tests. Every authoritative MCR item is mapped, intentionally excluded, or marked unresolved with source reference.

implementationSequence.name: Finish migration Phases 5-7
implementationSequence.details: Introduce repositories, EffectiveSite model, and switch Admin Center/application consumers to same database-backed source.

implementationSequence.name: Portal Library UX enhancements
implementationSequence.details: Add ID # columns, relation links, explicit Coverage subtables, Patterns/Flags tabs, common filters and exports against repository data.

implementationSequence.name: Portal Admin parity/retirement
implementationSequence.details: Verify every legacy datum is represented and editable/readable in Admin Center before deleting legacy pages.

acceptancePrinciples: No client-specific hard-coded branches; create/extend normalized abstractions instead.
Prototype clients must resolve to behavior equivalent to the known-good current source plus confirmed MCR additions.
Non-prototype MCR clients must be representable in the catalog without requiring a runnable prototype Site.
Every Portal Library row has ID #, semantic key, Provided by, and source reference metadata where applicable.
All relationships are explicit enough to query, export, link and audit.
Unresolved MCR items stay unresolved and traceable; do not invent answers.
